images.name: 04_the_gate_between_the_nets
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE photoreal landscape 16:9 concept image, not a collage. Abandoned 1990s indoor soft-play centre in a gigantic warehouse, empty Backrooms co-op hide-and-seek horror. Match style_frame's photoreal worn vinyl, dusty shadow, net texture; sheet_ingame only supplies actual colours and parts, never its UI or old low scale. Height diagram when supplied is SCALE only, never reproduce diagram or text. Hall roof 34 metres high, cathedral-high exposed steel deck, joists and ducts almost lost in darkness. City-block-size play frame six storeys high, 2.8 metres per storey; seven in Tube Town and ten in Tower. Sparse cold-white fluorescent strips far overhead, several dead, pools of light and long shadows, light haze. Slightly brighter and more saturated than a real derelict building so colours read. Blue-and-green checkerboard foam puzzle floor, worn, a few missing tiles exposing grey concrete. Steel posts wrapped in yellow/red/blue/green vinyl padding; BLACK knotted safety net fences; coloured vinyl mat decks; occasional square red panels with round clear bubble windows. Glossy moulded slides each a SINGLE solid colour, never striped or black. Few scattered plastic balls. No people, children, animals, entity, arcade cabinets, claw machines, prize shelves, neon, watermark, HUD, UI. No full ball pit. No lettering except explicitly requested sign. Wide lens. Frame exterior must show at least SIX clearly separate stacked storeys, never just three. Render as one cohesive believable photograph.

SCENE:
Standing three metres in front of the West Gate: gateway FOUR metres wide between two tall black net fences on padded yellow and red posts, padded BLUE lintel above it carrying a worn painted sign reading exactly "PLAY ZONE". Only text is PLAY ZONE, correctly spelled. Beyond, blue-and-green checker lane runs ten metres into frame and turns out of sight; decks, nets and tubes stacked SIX STOREYS overhead on BOTH sides close over lane like canyon. Show six distinct deck tiers above/around gate and vast high roof beyond. Only ONE working fluorescent tube far above; lane darker than hall. Eye height looking slightly upward so height shows.

STRICT correction: Every tube must be entirely ONE colour from end to end, including every segment; ignore multicoloured tubes in reference. Only ONE lit fluorescent fixture in the ENTIRE image. Compose wider upward to show SIX full stacked deck tiers on both sides, none cropped away. Lane turns visibly at ten metres.
images.weakness: Upper decks are cropped, preventing a reliable six-storey count; the lane reads longer than ten metres and an extra distant light remains.
